title: New reporting to the pilot group
transcript:
[00:00] Ruth: The new reporting dashboards are feature complete. Pavel, how's performance?
[00:05] Pavel: Under two seconds for every chart on our biggest test workspace.
[00:10] Ines: The CSV export from the charts is in too.
[00:14] Ruth: Great. Then let's ship it to the pilot group on Monday.
[00:19] Pavel: Monday works. I'll flip the flag first thing.
[00:23] Ines: I'll write the what's-new note that shows up when they open reporting.
[00:29] Ruth: Keep it short. Three bullets and a link.
[00:33] Ines: Sure.
[00:37] Pavel: Do we want usage tracking on each chart?
[00:41] Ruth: Yes, chart opens and exports. I'll want those numbers in two weeks.
[00:47] Pavel: I'll add the events before Monday.
[00:51] Ruth: Thanks, both.
